method: Pilot, timed with a stopwatch on Oct 25, 2026. Task: find two climate startups that are already making revenue, and one grant or competition I could apply to this month. First using only the Yale Startup Directory (yalepitchbook.com) and the Tsai CITY board, then using only found. (I used Scout, the chat helper). The tester is me: a Yale SOM student and co-lead of the SOM Startup & Entrepreneurship Club, the kind of person found. is for; I am also the builder, so this is a pilot, not an independent study.

participants.who: Madison Andoniadis, Yale SOM student, co-lead of the SOM Startup & Entrepreneurship Club (also the builder)
participants.quote: The Yale Pitchbook directory's industry categories are terrible: somehow both broad AND narrow AND repetitive (Healthcare, Healthcare & Biotechnology, Technology, Storage & Moving). Ours is better.
